notes.title: Operation KREEP 1.2 update [+Trading Cards]
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The 1.2 update for Operation KREEP is live, containing:
[list]
    [*]3 new maps, totaling 20 arenas now.
    [*]Difficulty fine tuning and enhancements for the "Sudden Death" mechanic.
    [*]User interface streamlining to allow easier match restart or reconfiguration.
    [*]Input (keyboard & controller) handling refinements and fixes.
    [*]New "evil CEO" endings ːsteammockingː.
[/list]
And the biggest addition of all:
[h1]Steam Trading Cards!!![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25279227/23e818aa0687d43e970130e42122bc5a6d7e3950.png[/img]
